messages:
maria_cs: quick capture from a handful of customer check-ins today. dropping raw bullets for product triage. top asks/notes: 1) exportable renewal-health report (CSV) with usage, incidents, and enablement completion; 2) per-feature token attribution (not just per-route or orgtotal) so finance can chargeback to product teams; 3) onboarding flow automation to pre-seed connectors and minimize manual steps; 4) small UX: show last migration / embedding generation timestamp in the index panel.
kevin_onboarding: +1 on renewal-health CSV. customers want a single artifact for renewal decks. suggested columns: customer_id, renewal_date, monthly_avg_tokens, incidents_last_90d, enablement_pct_complete, last_support_touch.
anya_support: we also get support asks to see "token by API key" — some customers run multiple teams under one org and need per-team attribution.
sam_product: sounds like two deliverables: a) renewal-health export that aggregates existing signals; b) a new token-attribution signal (API key / feature). which is higher priority?
luis_sales: renewal-health export is highest priority for any at-risk accounts. Sales will use it in the deck. token-attribution is higher value but can be phase 2.
jamie_pm: propose MVP: Renewal CSV that pulls current metrics (usage, incidents, enablement status). scope: backend aggregation + export endpoint + minimal UI to download. Estimate: 2 sprints. Token-attribution: requires request-level logging and lineage, estimate 4 sprints.
eva_data: confirmable. For MVP I can build a scheduled aggregate that joins usage_events, incident_tally, enablement_progress. CSV endpoint is straightforward after aggregation.
maria_cs: a few customer quotes I pulled (redacted): "we need a one-pager for renewals that shows usage trends and enablement progress" and "finance asks for team-level token breakdown".
kevin_onboarding: on onboarding automation: customers trip over steps where they must manually upload embeddings or toggle an index flag. can we add a simple checkbox in onboarding to "auto-seed demo index" and a task checklist they can share?
sam_product: auto-seed demo index sounds small if we provide templates. Could be a devex task rather than heavy infra.
jamie_pm: prioritization: 1) renewal CSV (ship early), 2) onboarding checkbox + checklist, 3) token-by-API-key attribution, 4) index metadata timestamp.
anya_support: I'll gather 5 sample customer support threads showing the API-key ask and paste samples to the ticket.
triage-bot: reminder: create JIRA epic CS-RENEW-3001 "Renewal health export & enablement report".
maria_cs: action items: eva to post a data spec draft by Tue, sam to author a short product brief with MVP fields, kevin to prototype onboarding checklist copy, jamie to schedule triage slot. I'll notify the customers that a renewal report MVP is prioritized. :thumbsup:
